summary: Mr. Harari discusses the minhagim for taking out the Sefer Torah during Minchah on Shabbat. He explains the custom regarding Berich Sheme according to Halab and early Brooklyn, and the practice of wearing a jacket when receiving honors.
questions: Do we say Berich Sheme during Minchah of Shabbat?
What is the custom in Halab regarding taking out the Sefer Torah at Minchah?
Why is wearing a jacket important when receiving an honor at the Sefer Torah?
